consequence.statement: Traffic from policy-selected node-local backends to the policy's frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends by default, when socket-based load-balancing is enabled.
consequence.remediation: Create local redirect policies with skipRedirectFromBackend set to true to override this behavior.

assertion.statement: With socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policy now by default redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends; set skipRedirectFromBackend to true to override.
